idea-plugin.name: Compose Recomposition Auditor
idea-plugin.description:
Detects Jetpack Compose recomposition issues directly in the editor — before you ever need to run a profiler. The plugin reproduces (a conservative subset of) the Compose compiler's own stability inference to catch problems as you type.

Detected issues

  • Mutable collection interfaces (List, Map, Set) passed as @Composable parameters
  • Classes with var properties passed as @Composable parameters, without @Stable/@Immutable
  • Types defined outside the current module whose stability cannot be determined
  • Lambdas inside a @Composable function that capture a local var without remember

Quick-fixes

  • Convert to Immutable* — rewrites List<T> / Map<K,V> / Set<T> to their kotlinx.collections.immutable equivalents, adding both the import and the Gradle dependency automatically
  • Annotate class with @Stable — adds the @Stable annotation to the offending class declaration

False-positive reduction

Skips @Preview-annotated composables, and recognizes a small whitelist of well-known stable Compose/coroutines types (Modifier, State, StateFlow, etc.) that can't otherwise be proven stable from binary metadata alone.
